RE: Follow up from our meeting on April 16
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Kevin Wysocki Tuesday, June 8, 2021 at 11:53:31 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Joshua Machleder
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Mike Bradow, [contact omitted] Amy Malessa, [contact omitted] Adam Kaplan,
[contact omitted] Diana Parzik, [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Payton lheme
Hi Josh,
We look forward to our meeting a little later today!
We have a team member that is joining the call with a focus on learning more about the "Summit of Democracies."
Talk to you soon!
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Wednesday, June 2, 2021 1:40 PM
To: Kevin Wysocki < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]>; Adam Kaplan <[contact omitted]>;
Diana Parzik <[contact omitted]>; Shannon Maguire <[contact omitted]>; Payton Iheme q [opaque block]
Subject: Re: Follow up from our meeting on April 16
Thanks Kevin,
Could we take the Tuesday 6/8: 1:30 - 2:00 PM EST slot?
What's the best platform to speak on? We use Google meets and I'm happy to send out a calendar
invite, if that works for you.
Best,
josh
On Wed, Jun 2, 2021 at 12:08 PM Kevin Wysocki < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh,
I hope you are having a nice day. I spoke with Payton and Mike here at FB and the times below for next week would
vork well for us. Please let me know if one of them will work for USAID.
Monday: 3:30 - 4:00 PM EST
Tuesday: 1:30 - 2:00 PM EST or 3:00 - 3:30 PM EST

From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Wednesday, June 2, 2021 9:06 AM
To: Payton Iheme < [opaque block]
Cc: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]>; Adam Kaplan
<[contact omitted]>; Diana Parzik <[contact omitted]>; Shannon Maguire <[contact omitted]>; Kevin Wysocki
[opaque block]
Subject: Re: Follow up from our meeting on April 16
Hi Payton,
Just wanted to check in with you to see whether you might still be available to speak this week.
All best,
Josh
On Thu, May 27, 2021 at 5:34 PM Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Payton,
Thanks for your response. We are happy to talk about these issues, including the Summit for
Democracies, which is very much in its planning stages.
Would next week on Thursday or Friday, any time between 1 - 3 work for you?
Best,
josh
On Thu,May 27,2021 at 3:23 PM Payton Iheme < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
How about we set up a call next week? We would look forward to that.
In addition to are meet and great, we would be interested in learning more about the The Summit of Democracies
and how we can help.
We have quite a bit of overlap with human rights digital issues in the various countries our platform operates in, so
I think that may be one area of immediate overlap.
And of course several others.
Best,
Payton
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Date: Tuesday, May 18, 2021 at 1:47 PM

To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]>, Adam Kaplan <[contact omitted]>, Diana
Parzik <[contact omitted]>, Shannon Maguire <[contact omitted]>, Payton lheme
[opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Follow up from our meeting on April 16
Thanks, Mike -- and greetings, Payton. We are happy to continue the conversation at any time.
Best, Josh
On Tue, May 18, 2021 at 12:05 PM Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh et al,
Thanks again for reaching out with these ideas for partnership. I'm looping in Payton lheme, our USG outreach
lead to discuss further.
Best,
Mike
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Friday, May 14, 2021 6:37 PM
To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>

Best,
josh

hanks. Josh and team for the convo and pullina this together. At first alance. I think there are a lot of area

Have a great weekend!

From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Friday, May 14, 2021 9:57 AM
To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>

Cc: Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]>; Adam Kaplan <[contact omitted]>; Diana Parzik
<[contact omitted]>; Shannon Maguire <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Follow up from our meeting on April 16
Hi Mike,
Thanks again for taking the time to meet with me and my colleagues at USAID last month. I'm attaching, for
your consideration, a draft document that provides an exploratory look at what a more formal partnership
between USAID and Facebook might look like on content policy issue in contexts where USAID is working.
It is a product of our team's thinking following our meeting that seeks to align existing Facebook and USAID
initiatives so that we may increase our impact in creating resilient information ecosystems in the countries
Please let us know your thoughts about the feasibility and appropriateness of such a partnership and the
suggested terms from Facebook's side.
Many thanks in advance. I look forward to your response.
Best,
Josh
